cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. Down lands on Development and Enter connects. Query 1 in acme_prod › public is accepted only once the status says Connected to Development and Loading schema is gone. Ctrl+Y opens Query history. Ctrl+W returns to Query 1. Ctrl+Q exits 0. This path does not open a confirmation dialog.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; Down to Development; Enter
cases.return_path: Ctrl+Y opens Query history; Ctrl+W returns to Query 1; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: Development starts Silent. Ctrl+L opens Safe Mode · this connection, and Enter on Alert saves that level. An UPDATE with a WHERE opens Execute write query? with fact Alert · confirm before running, no type field, and Execute focused. Esc sets Cancelled · nothing was executed and leaves no History entry for CancelMarkerT03. Safe Mode then opens the same dialog with fact Safe Mode · type to confirm and the drawn label Type organizations to confirm. Esc cancels that dialog too, and History still has neither marker. The unarmed dialog is captured at 120×40 and then at 80×24, before the terminal returns to 120×40. nope and the prefix organization set Does not match, leave the dialog open, and do not run. The exact token organizations runs once: UPDATE organizations · 8 rows affected · 12 ms, and History lists ExactMarkerT03 once. Ctrl+R opens a new Execute write query? dialog instead of running again. Esc on that dialog leaves the history count at one. The unsaved query quits through Quit TablePro?.
cases.action_sequence: Cancel an ordinary confirmation and a typed confirmation. Enter a wrong, partial, and exact phrase.
cases.expected_results: Wrong and partial text do not execute. Exact text executes once.
cases.forbidden_effects: Cancel leaves a new History entry.
